facets.description: Server schema (addGuests.schema.ts) and handler's uniqueGuests filter never dedupe guests within a single request (the uniqueness refine exists only on the client), so duplicate emails in one call create duplicate Attendee rows
The handler reads attendees, filters them, then runs createMany (handler lines 74-106). This check-then-insert sequence is a TOCTOU race, so concurrent requests can both insert the same new guest
